name: minimind
description: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
one_liner: A complete, minimal recipe for training your own tiny (64-million-parameter) language model from scratch in about two hours, including all the code.
buyer: A computer-science instructor or self-taught engineer who wants a hands-on, affordable way to actually understand how LLMs are built, not just use one.
business_use_cases: A bootcamp or university builds a paid 'build your own LLM' workshop around the repo's step-by-step training pipeline.
A hardware reviewer benchmarks new GPUs by having an audience reproduce the training run and compare times.
A consultancy uses the codebase as a teaching sandbox before scaling clients up to real production model training.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid, guided video course that walks through the repo end-to-end with exercises.
Offer a hosted 'train it in the cloud' version so non-technical learners skip the GPU setup.

steal_this: Turn the repo into a weekend cohort-based course: charge a small fee, run it live over Discord, and let each learner finish with their own trained model.
